Quanto custa uma landing page?: How much does a landing page cost?
O investimento médio é de R$ 1.260, com: The average investment is R$ 1.260, with projects between R$ 750 and R$ 1.800. The Essential tier goes from R$ 750 to R$ 1.090; the Strategic tier, with copy, analytics and technical SEO, goes from R$ 1.200 to R$ 1.600; and Campaign starts at R$ 1.800. The final price is set after discovery.
Preciso ter os textos prontos?: Do I need to have the copy ready?
Não. Na faixa Estratégica a copy está in: No. In the Strategic tier, copywriting is included: the copy is written from the discovery and sent for your approval before design. In Essential, you send the content and it is reviewed and organized on the page.
Landing page funciona sem anúncios?: Does a landing page work without ads?
Sim. Ela pode receber visitas do Instagr: Yes. It can receive visits from Instagram, your bio link, Google, referrals or campaigns. Results depend on the offer, the audience and the quality of that traffic. The page organizes the message and makes the desired action easy.
Consigo editar a página depois?: Can I edit the page later?
Sim. Pequenas alterações entram na manut: Yes. Small changes are covered by the six-month maintenance plan and larger changes are quoted separately. When the page is built on WordPress, you can also edit text and images directly in the dashboard.

Entre 10 e 15 dias úteis a partir do env: Between 10 and 15 business days after the materials are sent. What affects the timeline most is how quickly each step is approved.
